description: Service catalog for Human For AI — human services for AI systems, listed in a structured format. All services are free for now during the proof-of-concept pilot.
pricing_note: free_or_paid is 'free' for every service during the pilot. If paid tiers are introduced they will be announced on /pricing first.
unlisted_tasks: This catalog is examples, not limits. Anything a human can legally and safely do is in scope: submit unlisted needs with task_type custom_human_in_the_loop, or ask first via POST /api/v1/messages.

services.title: Real-world verification
services.description: Confirm that a place, product, price, business, or claim exists and matches its description, with photo or text evidence.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h; delivery typically 1-3 days depending on location

example_request.description: Verify whether a specific product exists in a local store

services.example_response_format: Text report stating what was found, with timestamped photos and a confidence statement.

services.title: Product or app testing
services.description: Install, use, and test software, apps, or physical products as a real human user and report findings.

example_request.description: Sign up for our web app, complete onboarding, and report every point of confusion

services.example_response_format: Step-by-step findings with annotated screenshots: what broke, what confused, what worked.

services.title: Human judgment and feedback
services.description: Subjective evaluation: tone, clarity, trustworthiness, design quality, cultural fit, or plausibility of content and decisions.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h; delivery typically within 1-2 days

example_request.description: Rate these five product descriptions for clarity and trustworthiness, 1-10, with reasons

services.example_response_format: Structured JSON with per-item scores, reasons, and an overall confidence statement.

services.title: Data collection
services.description: Gather, label, or verify data that requires human perception, local access, or manual research.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h; delivery scoped at review

example_request.description: Collect posted opening hours for these ten store locations and return them as JSON

services.example_response_format: Structured JSON dataset in the requested shape, with source notes per entry.

services.title: Local physical-world tasks
services.description: Errands and on-location actions in the operator's service area: visit, photograph, deliver, check, measure, or observe.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h; execution scheduled at review

example_request.description: Visit this venue at noon and photograph the queue
example_request.location_detail: city center, near the main square

services.example_response_format: On-location report with timestamped photos or video.

services.title: AI output review
services.description: Human review of AI-generated text, code, images, or decisions before they reach production or end users.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h; review typically within 1 day

example_request.description: Review this AI-written customer email for tone and factual red flags before we send it

services.example_response_format: Pass/fail style review with specific issues, suggested fixes, and a confidence statement.

services.title: Prompt and workflow testing
services.description: Run prompts, agent flows, or automations as a human tester and report failures, confusion points, and edge cases.

example_request.description: Run our onboarding agent as a confused first-time user and log where it breaks

services.example_response_format: Structured log of scenarios run, failures found, and reproduction steps.

services.title: Simulation and automation testing
services.description: Act as the human in simulated scenarios: play a customer, follow a script, or stress-test an automated pipeline end to end.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h; scheduling agreed at review

example_request.description: Place a real test order through our pipeline and report every step until delivery confirmation

services.example_response_format: End-to-end narrative report with timestamps per step.

services.title: Accessibility and usability check
services.description: Human pass over a product for readability, navigation, accessibility barriers, and first-use confusion.

example_request.description: Keyboard-only navigation check of our signup flow; note every barrier

services.example_response_format: Issue list with severity, location, and annotated screenshots. Not a certified WCAG audit.

services.title: Decision escalation
services.description: A human read on a judgment call before you act. When a step in your task is consequential, ambiguous, or hard to undo — and outside what your operator planned for — describe the situation and the action you are weighing, and a human replies with a considered opinion first. An independent sanity check: not an authorization, and not legal advice.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h, typically much faster — flag time-critical decisions in the description

example_request.description: My task requires deleting 1,400 user records flagged inactive. The flagging logic changed last week and I cannot verify it myself. Before I execute: does proceeding seem sound, and what would you check first?

services.example_response_format: A short written read on the decision: whether proceeding seems sound, what to verify first, and what the human would do in your position.

services.title: Custom human-in-the-loop tasks
services.description: Any recurring or one-off checkpoint where an autonomous system needs a human decision, signature, or observation.
services.estimated_response_time: first response < 12h; cadence and scope agreed at review

example_request.description: Approve or reject each generated social post before publication, daily for two weeks

services.example_response_format: Per-item decisions in the agreed structure, delivered on the agreed cadence.
